articles.title: As crypto perpetual futures boom, Ethereum’s role is shifting
articles.snippet: Rather than competing directly with faster chains, some builders argue Ethereum's strength lies in supporting the layer-2 networks where trading is taking place.

articles.title: Nvidia, Microsoft and IBM Launch Open Secure AI Alliance to Strengthen AI Cybersecurity
articles.snippet: More than 40 technology companies and organizations have allied to develop open-source AI security tools and standards for cyber defense.
